mainEntity.name: Can a Range Rover V8 engine fit my Discovery 3?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sometimes, but not without checks. Range Rover and Jaguar V8 engines can differ in ancillaries, wiring and calibration, so we compare your VIN and engine code with any replacement before supply.

mainEntity.name: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt Discovery V8 engines compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing V8. We recommend an option after assessing the fault.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a Discovery 3 V8 engine supply only?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

mainEntity.name: What affects the Discovery 3 engine replacement cost for a 448PN?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any cooling or ancillary parts needed and the labour involved, including body-lift work. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

mainEntity.name: Is there a warranty on a replacement 448PN engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver Land Rover V8 engines across the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

mainEntity.name: How long does a 448PN engine replacement usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed, any body-lift work and additional repairs found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed.
